scientific_integrity: Proof-based mathematical claim supported by exact finite checks. Finite checks alone are not used to infer any infinite theorem; bibliography was compared but no independent priority review occurred.
scientific_limitations: Uniform profile and effective distribution for the complementary golden-ratio pair only; no bounded-error or general Beatty-pair claim. Shallit 2020 already supplies a rank-19 exact linear representation of this counting function, so priority for the explicit asymptotic and distributional formulation requires independent literature assessment.
title: Phase-resolved fluctuations of mixed Wythoff representation counts
